item.title: Making a Doctor's Appointment
item.summary: A student abroad phones a clinic about a sore throat and changes the first appointment time he is offered.
item.transcript_text:
Receptionist: Good morning, Riverside Medical Centre. How can I help?
Jasur: Hello. I'd like to make an appointment with a doctor, please.
Receptionist: Of course. Are you registered with us?
Jasur: Yes, I registered last month. I'm a student at the university.
Receptionist: Can I have your name and date of birth?
Jasur: It's Jasur Aliyev, and I was born on the fifth of March, two thousand and four.
Receptionist: Thank you. And what's the problem?
Jasur: I've had a sore throat for a week, and now I have a cough too.
Receptionist: I see. The first appointment is on Thursday at a quarter past eleven. Is that OK?
Jasur: Thursday's difficult, I have an exam. Is there anything earlier?
Receptionist: Let me check. Yes, there's one tomorrow at twenty to nine with Dr Patel.
Jasur: That's perfect, thank you.
Receptionist: Please come ten minutes early. See you tomorrow.
